responsibility: Architecture-specific assembly macro include for the Android implementation of GNAT’s signal trampoline service. It does not define the C entry point itself; instead it emits the target-dependent asm text used by sigtramp-android.c to build the real trampoline symbol, including prologue/epilogue fragments, ARM unwind annotations, frame/register-save description, and text-section setup so the unwinder can reconstruct the interrupted signal context and step past Android signal frames.
